Zweilous

Dark Dragon

Unova · Generation 5

Zweilous is a Dark/Dragon-type Hostile Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1.4 m tall and weighs 50 kg. It evolves from Deino and into Hydreigon. Its highest base stat is Attack (85), with a base stat total of 420.
